variables.name: header
variables.comment: The default values for samples from the track fragment header.

variables.name: atomPosition
variables.comment: The position (byte offset) of the start of fragment.

variables.name: dataPosition
variables.comment: The position (byte offset) of the start of data contained in the fragment.

variables.name: auxiliaryDataPosition
variables.comment: The position (byte offset) of the start of auxiliary data.

variables.name: trunCount
variables.comment: The number of track runs of the fragment.

variables.name: sampleCount
variables.comment: The total number of samples in the fragment.

variables.name: trunDataPosition
variables.comment: The position (byte offset) of the start of sample data of each track run in the fragment.

variables.name: trunLength
variables.comment: The number of samples contained by each track run in the fragment.

variables.name: sampleSizeTable
variables.comment: The size of each sample in the fragment.

variables.name: samplePresentationTimesUs
variables.comment: The presentation time of each sample in the fragment, in microseconds.

variables.name: sampleIsSyncFrameTable
variables.comment: Indicates which samples are sync frames.

variables.name: definesEncryptionData
variables.comment: Whether the fragment defines encryption data.

variables.name: sampleHasSubsampleEncryptionTable
variables.comment:
* If {@link #definesEncryptionData} is true, indicates which samples use sub-sample encryption.
   * Undefined otherwise.

variables.name: trackEncryptionBox
variables.comment: Fragment specific track encryption. May be null.

variables.name: sampleEncryptionData
variables.comment:
* If {@link #definesEncryptionData} is true, contains binary sample encryption data. Undefined
   * otherwise.

variables.name: sampleEncryptionDataNeedsFill
variables.comment: Whether {@link #sampleEncryptionData} needs populating with the actual encryption data.

variables.name: nextFragmentDecodeTime
nextFragmentDecodeTimeIncludesMoov
variables.comment:
* Whether {@link #nextFragmentDecodeTime} includes the duration of the samples referred to by the
   * moov atom.

methods.name: public void reset()
methods.comment:
* Resets the fragment. * *

{@link #sampleCount} and {@link #nextFragmentDecodeTime} are set to 0, and both {@link * #definesEncryptionData} and {@link #sampleEncryptionDataNeedsFill} is set to false, and {@link * #trackEncryptionBox} is set to null.

methods.name: public void initTables(int trunCount, int sampleCount)
methods.comment:
* Configures the fragment for the specified number of samples. * *

The {@link #sampleCount} of the fragment is set to the specified sample count, and the * contained tables are resized if necessary such that they are at least this length. * * @param sampleCount The number of samples in the new run.

methods.name: public void initEncryptionData(int length)
methods.comment:
* Configures the fragment to be one that defines encryption data of the specified length. * *

{@link #definesEncryptionData} is set to true, and the {@link ParsableByteArray#limit() * limit} of {@link #sampleEncryptionData} is set to the specified length. * * @param length The length in bytes of the encryption data.

methods.name: public void fillEncryptionData(ExtractorInput input) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Fills {@link #sampleEncryptionData} from the provided input.
   *
   * @param input An {@link ExtractorInput} from which to read the encryption data.

methods.name: public void fillEncryptionData(ParsableByteArray source)
methods.comment:
* Fills {@link #sampleEncryptionData} from the provided source.
   *
   * @param source A source from which to read the encryption data.

methods.name: public long getSamplePresentationTimeUs(int index)
methods.comment:
* Returns the sample presentation timestamp in microseconds.
   *
   * @param index The sample index.
   * @return The presentation timestamps of this sample in microseconds.

methods.name: public boolean sampleHasSubsampleEncryptionTable(int index)
methods.comment: Returns whether the sample at the given index has a subsample encryption table.

methodNames: public void initTables(int trunCount, int sampleCount)
public void fillEncryptionData(ExtractorInput input) throws IOException
